title: 1 Chronicles Bible Quiz - Chapter 27
description: Ten questions on 1 Chronicles 27: the twelve monthly army divisions, the rulers of the tribes, and the officials over King David's property.

questions.text: How many men were there in every division that served the king month by month?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 27:1 says that of every division there were twenty-four thousand.

questions.text: Who was over the first division for the first month?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 27:2 says Jashobeam the son of Zabdiel was over the first division for the first month.

questions.text: Benaiah, the captain for the third month, was the son of whom?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 27:5 says the third captain was Benaiah, the son of Jehoiada the chief priest.

answers.text: Zabdiel, of the children of Perez

questions.text: What is said about Benaiah in verse 6?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 27:6 says Benaiah was the mighty man of the thirty, and over the thirty.

answers.text: He was the king's counselor and a scribe
He was the mighty man of the thirty, and over the thirty
He was over the king's treasures in the cities
He was over the herds that fed in Sharon

questions.text: Asahel, the captain for the fourth month, was the brother of whom?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 27:7 says the fourth captain was Asahel the brother of Joab.

questions.text: Who was the ruler over the tribe of Judah?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 27:16-18 lists the rulers over the tribes of Israel; of Judah it was Elihu, one of the brothers of David.

answers.text: Elihu, one of the brothers of David
Zadok, of the sons of Aaron

questions.text: Why did David not take the number of those twenty years old and under?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 27:23 says this was because Yahweh had said he would increase Israel like the stars of the sky.

answers.text: Joab had already counted them in the army
The Levites had counted them the year before
Yahweh had said he would increase Israel like the stars of the sky
They were living outside the land of Israel

questions.text: What happened when Joab the son of Zeruiah began to take a census?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 27:24 says Joab began to take a census but did not finish, and wrath came on Israel for this.

answers.text: He finished it in nine months
He did not finish, and wrath came on Israel
The number was written in the book of the kings

questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 27:30 says Obil the Ishmaelite was over the camels.

questions.text: Who is called the king's friend?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 27:33 says Hushai the Archite was the king's friend.
